parameters.name: GroupField
parameters.description:
The filter condition. Valid values:

*   **pod**: pod
*   **appName**: application name
*   **clusterId**: cluster ID
*   **namespace**: namespace
*   **image**: image
*   **containerScan**: container scan

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The value of the filter condition. The value can be an application name, node name, namespace, cluster name, public IP address, pod address, region, pod, instance ID, cluster ID, or container ID. Fuzzy match is supported.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas describe-container-criteria --group-field clusterId --value cfb41a869c71e4678a97021582dd8a0000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas DescribeContainerCriteria --region cn-hangzhou --GroupField clusterId --Value cfb41a869c71e4678a97021582dd8a0000
